root.label: Copy elision and NRVO
root.note: C++17 separates guaranteed prvalue initialization from optional compiler elision such as NRVO.

children.label: Mandatory prvalue elision
children.note: Prvalues are unmaterialized initializers that construct directly inside the destination slot.

children.label: No ctor required
children.note: Types with deleted copy and move constructors can still be returned by prvalue.

children.label: Chained factory calls
children.note: Nested prvalue returns forward the target slot without creating intermediate objects.

children.label: Where it stops
children.note: Assignment, slicing conversions, and named locals still require assignment or ctors.

children.label: Optional NRVO
children.note: Compilers may fuse a named automatic local variable directly into the caller return slot.

children.label: Accessible ctor needed
children.note: Because NRVO is optional, the returned type must still expose a copy or move constructor.

children.label: Throw and catch elision
children.note: The standard also permits eliding copies when throwing locals or catching by value.

children.label: What disables NRVO
children.note: Several common patterns prevent the compiler from aliasing a local with the return slot.

children.label: return std::move(local)
children.note: Casting the returned variable to an xvalue blocks NRVO and forces an explicit move.

children.label: Function parameters
children.note: ABI parameter storage forbids NRVO on parameters, though implicit move still applies.

children.label: Multiple distinct locals
children.note: Returning different local variables on separate branches usually defeats NRVO.

children.label: Members and globals
children.note: Subobjects and non-automatic objects cannot occupy the caller return slot directly.

children.label: Implicit move fallback
children.note: When NRVO does not run, plain return local tries rvalue move resolution automatically.

children.label: Rvalue-first overload lookup
children.note: Overload resolution tries treating the returned local or parameter as an rvalue first.

children.label: C++23 P2266R3 rule
children.note: Simpler implicit move treats move-eligible id-expressions uniformly across return conversions.

children.label: Best practice rule
children.note: Write plain return local to preserve NRVO when possible and implicit move otherwise.
